# git: config: set push.autoSetupRemote to true

Stop typing `git push -u origin <branch>` for every new branch. **Motivation:** simplicity — Git 2.37's `push.autoSetupRemote` (the [tweet](https://twitter.com/JI/status/1546948817462800384) that announced it) makes a bare `git push` on a branch without upstream create the remote branch and set tracking, which is what the flow's `progress`/`done` steps and `git please` assume.
